overview: Investigar por que o provider primário 0x629F44 não está disponível no runner parcial e mapear os caminhos de package, backend e FMV sem aplicar patches cegos.
goals: Identificar quem cria ou deveria preencher 0x629F44.
Mapear a tabela de backend de 0x3991F0 e seus dispatches indiretos.
Adicionar apenas instrumentação env-gated quando a análise estática não bastar.
Produzir evidência reproduzível e um próximo experimento mínimo.
nonGoals: Não forçar handles válidos ou SignalSema.
Não alterar o runtime original nem os assets da ISO.
Não implementar o skip de FMV nesta fase.
Não permitir que dois agentes escrevam no mesmo arquivo simultaneamente.
successMetrics: Cada história gera um relatório com endereços, arquivos e evidência.
O produtor de 0x629F44 ou o ponto exato de perda do valor é identificado.
O probe registra o valor do provider sem mudar o comportamento padrão quando o env-gate está desligado.
O lote termina com um único próximo experimento aprovado por evidência.
openQuestions: O provider primário é criado por uma fábrica virtual, por resposta SIF/IOP ou por inicialização de pacote anterior?
Qual valor e qual sequência aparecem no PCSX2 real antes de 0x4F9760?
O bloqueio atual é independente do caminho de vídeo/FMV?

stack.framework: C++ PS2 recompilation + PowerShell batch tools
stack.agentMode: Small read-only investigation stories first; mutation stories serial

rules: Read-only stories may run in parallel only when their allowedPaths do not overlap.
Only one story may edit generated C++ or run compile/relink at a time.
Every story must record a positive example and a negative case.
All runtime experiments remain behind MC3_* env-gates until compared with PCSX2 evidence.
Do not launch PCSX2 fullscreen or mutate the original ISO.
qualityGates: Static evidence command exits successfully and names exact files/addresses.
Generated object compilation passes for every edited function.
10_link_partial_runner.bat completes and mc3_partial.exe has a new timestamp when code is edited.
Default probe behavior is unchanged when the new env-gate is absent.
No unreviewed direct write to 0x629F44, fake handle, semaphore injection, or permanent compatibility patch.

stories.title: Inventory provider global references
stories.description: As an investigator, I want a complete reference inventory for 0x629F40, 0x629F41, 0x629F44, 0x629F4C and 0x629F50 so that producers and consumers are not guessed.
acceptanceCriteria: Report every relevant read/write with exact file and address.
Example: 0x4F9760 reads 0x629F44 and 0x629F4C.
Negative case: references that only contain an instruction address such as 0x4F9F44 are excluded.
No source file is modified.

stories.title: Map backend table and indirect calls
stories.description: As an investigator, I want the 0x3991F0 backend table and indirect call targets mapped so that the provider creation path is concrete.
acceptanceCriteria: Map table bases 0x618020 and 0x618024 and every indirect call used by 0x3991F0.
Example: identify the vtable slot and the function called after the backend lookup.
Negative case: do not label an unknown indirect target as a provider constructor without evidence.
Produce a standalone markdown result.

stories.title: Map provider lifecycle flags
stories.description: As an investigator, I want the lifecycle around 0x4FA7A8, 0x4FAED8, 0x4F9A68 and 0x4FAA10 mapped so that initialization order is known.
acceptanceCriteria: Document flag reads, writes, branches and return values for the four functions.
Example: 0x4FAED8 reads flags 0x629F40 and 0x629F41 before continuing.
Negative case: a flag write in an unrelated function is not treated as provider initialization.
No runtime behavior changes.

stories.title: Add provider entry trace
stories.description: As an investigator, I want env-gated entry and exit telemetry for the provider chain so that live values can be compared with static expectations.
acceptanceCriteria: Trace 0x3991F0, 0x4FAED8, 0x4F9A68 and 0x4F9760 with MC3_BOOT_TRACE or a new documented MC3_* gate.
Example: log primary, fallback, flags and relevant arguments at 0x4F9760 entry.
Negative case: with the env-gate absent, no new output or behavior occurs.
Edited functions compile individually before relink.

stories.title: Validate instrumented runner
stories.description: As an investigator, I want the instrumented runner rebuilt and probed so that the new telemetry is real and reproducible.
acceptanceCriteria: Compile only the affected batch and relink successfully.
Example: 15_auto_boot_probe.bat 8 595 produces latest_status.md and provider trace lines.
Negative case: a stale executable or missing object is reported as failure, not success.
Record Stable PC, provider values and last wait in a markdown checkpoint.

stories.title: Run controlled probe matrix
stories.description: As an investigator, I want a small matrix of existing probe modes compared so that a mode-specific SIF response is not confused with a provider fix.
acceptanceCriteria: Run the minimum matrix of default 8/595 and the previously validated req4 mode.
Example: compare Stable PC and provider values between the two modes.
Negative case: do not promote a mode that changes multiple unrelated experiments as a provider fix.
Keep each run log and record timestamps.

stories.title: Compare PCSX2 provider snapshot
stories.description: As an investigator, I want the native runner values compared with the existing PCSX2 evidence so that the next experiment is evidence-based.
acceptanceCriteria: Use the existing PCSX2 session evidence and identify matching provider/backend points.
Example: compare provider slot 0x618020, provider 0x619F58 and fallback state.
Negative case: timestamps or hashes alone cannot be used as gameplay equivalence evidence.
List unknown values that still require live capture.

stories.title: Select one minimal compatibility experiment
stories.description: As a maintainer, I want one ranked, env-gated experiment selected so that the next runtime change is small and reversible.
acceptanceCriteria: State the hypothesis, expected value, exact function/file, gate name and rollback path.
Example: a provider initialization response experiment with one changed request value.
Negative case: reject fake handles, semaphore injection and broad replace-all changes.
Do not implement the experiment in this story.

stories.title: Investigate FMV path separately
stories.description: As a maintainer, I want the video callback and package path mapped separately so that FMV work is not incorrectly blamed for the provider gate.
acceptanceCriteria: Map callbacks 0x541348 and 0x5413F0 and their package requests.
Example: identify whether the callback appears before or after the 0x5A8908 loop.
Negative case: do not add MC3_SKIP_VIDEO without a concrete player/decision function.
Produce findings only; no patch.

stories.title: Write end-of-batch handoff
stories.description: As Cloud, I want one concise handoff with verified findings, failed attempts and exact next commands so that the next session resumes without rediscovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Record what changed, what was verified, what remains unknown and the next command.
Example: include Stable PC, provider values and probe log paths.
Negative case: do not claim visual gameplay acceptance from hashes, counters or logs alone.
Leave the worktree and generated artifacts clearly described.
